_doc: mic.py intent lane (live/intents.py): the spoken answer when Dickie asks how to beat a unit (Jev intent counter_unit). One short, action-first line per unit for a Terran player with a Protoss ally. keys: whole words, any case, a space also matches a hyphen; the unit named first in the callout wins. After editing a line, render its clip: live\.python\python.exe live\voice\render_counters.py

Thor.line: Thors: Marauders, sieged Tanks, and Immortals from your ally.

Tempest.line: Tempests: mass Vikings and push before they pile up.

Carrier.line: Carriers: Vikings and Thors. Shoot the Carriers, not the Interceptors.

Colossus.line: Colossus: Vikings now, keep them over your army.

Immortal.line: Immortals: Marines and Ghosts. No Tanks or Thors into them.

Disruptor.line: Disruptors: spread out, back off the shot, then re-engage.

Lurker.line: Lurkers: scan first, then Tanks outrange them. Don't walk in.

Ultralisk.line: Ultras: Marauders and Ghosts, keep armor upgrades going.

Brood Lord.line: Brood Lords: Vikings now, hit before they mass.

Mutalisk.line: Mutas: Turret in every mineral line, more Marines, a Thor.

Baneling.line: Banelings: split your Marines, Tanks and Hellbats in front.

Liberator.line: Liberators: step out of the circle, Vikings on them.

Tank.line: Tanks: don't walk in. Drop behind them or flank wide.

Battlecruiser.line: Battlecruisers: Vikings and Thors, Turrets at home.

Viper.line: Vipers: Ghosts snipe them, Vikings out, spread your army.

Infestor.line: Infestors: Ghosts, snipe and EMP them. Spread against Fungal.

Roach.line: Roaches: Marauders and Tanks, Bunker at the natural.

Zealot.line: Zealots: Hellbats in front, Marauders with Concussive.

Stalker.line: Stalkers: Marauders with Concussive, watch your main's cliffs.

Marine.line: Marines: sieged Tanks, Hellbats, and Widow Mines.

Hellion.line: Hellions: wall off, Bunker at the natural, Marauders.

Banshee.line: Banshees: Turret in each mineral line, keep a scan, Vikings.

Oracle.line: Oracle: Turret in the main mineral line, Marines home.

DT.line: DTs: Turret in each mineral line, save a scan.
